salesOrderLineId.description: Confirmed sales order line this order fulfils (takes precedence over salesOrderId)

parentOrderId.description: V7: a DRAFT/APPROVED order that consumes this order's product; the new order becomes its child (due no later than the parent, no sales line)

lineId.description: Sales order line; defaults to the only open line of the lot product

uom.description: A unit code of the tenant (GET /units)

id.description: Existing line id when editing a draft (keeps the line identity)

ratio.description: Size in the kind's reference unit; omit for PACKAGE units

factor.description: Base units in one unit (1 bag = 25 kg)

unit.description: One scan = one of this unit; omit for the base unit

values.description: Attribute name -> value, one per family attribute

AdjustmentLine.description: DECREASE/INCREASE need lotId; FOUND needs itemId, warehouseId and unitCost (lotNumber optional).

id.description: Existing line id when editing a draft (keeps the line identity)

itemId.description: Active raw material, packaging or semi-finished item

quantity.description: In `unit`; converted exactly to the base unit (UnitService.toBaseExact)

unit.description: Base unit (default), a conversion flagged for purchase, or a same-kind standard unit

unitCost.description: Price per entered unit; the base unit cost is unitCost / factor (6 dp)

supplierId.description: Active supplier; optional on a draft, required to submit

dueDate.description: Expected delivery date of the order

supplierLot.description: Lot number (unique per tenant); generated from the GRN number when empty

receiptId.description: A quality-released receipt of this order

quantity.description: Billed base quantity; at most the open (received, not invoiced or returned) quantity

supplierReference.description: Supplier's invoice number (unique per supplier, case-insensitive)

quantity.description: Base quantity; ≤ received − returned and ≤ the lot’s unreserved stock
Base quantity, rounded up to the base unit precision

dueDate.description: Default: the latest line expected date (today + lead time)

machineId.description: Defaults to the parent's work center
